description: Target-node side of the dual-side integration contract, rendered on the node from the same Node Profile and generation as the BWH integration plan. Contains only safe references, digests, and public-key fingerprints in the registration anchor format (sha256:<lowercase hex>). Private keys (WireGuard, SSH, agent token) are generated on the node and never appear in this plan or any artifact; protocol material is pulled by the agent from the control plane by materialRef, never embedded here. Generation is a safe-reference string, as the agent protocol carries it. A conforming plan never authorises service activation: both activation flags are const false — activation happens only through the later gated workflows (P5/P6 control services, P8 traffic services). The WireGuard address is pinned to the approved plan for JP-01 (10.77.0.2/32; peer AllowedIPs are /32 entries inside 10.77.0.0/24); semantic CIDR validation is additionally enforced by the dual-side gate.

authFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of this node's agent token, anchor format; identical to the registration binding anchor agentAuthFingerprint. The token itself never appears.

addressCidr.description: JP-01's approved tunnel address (2026-11-02 address plan).

ownPublicKeyFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of this node's WireGuard public key, anchor format; identical to the BWH plan's nodePeerPublicKeyFingerprint and to the registration binding anchor.

peerPublicKeyFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the BWH WireGuard public key as expected by the node, anchor format; identical to the BWH plan's bwhPeerPublicKeyFingerprint.

title: Node Runtime Plan (dual-side contract, target-node side)
